findings.title: Amendment target is expressed as the historical WSR filing
findings.detail: Unit 65 says the section amends WSR 22-13-111. Unit 4 names WAC 456-10-730 and is a dependency, so the target is inferable in context. The explicit affected-object transition amend WAC 456-10-730 is not stated. This is partial recovery/normalization ambiguity, not a total discovery miss.

findings.title: Directive strength differs from the frozen AI reference
findings.detail: Advisory labels retain directed-to wording and appropriate conditions. The frozen reference treats the Teams information instruction as mandatory within its task and the assistance by-date as mandatory if requesting assistance, while the invitation itself is optional. Bare See and Contact do not explicitly say should/must, so these differences need adjudication rather than an automatic legal-force verdict. Unit 35 is the most consequential difference.

findings.detail: Examples include agency/notice/phase in unit 1, date/clock in 2 and 6, city/state in 9, and exemption status/basis/full scope in 59.
